#include "fdtd-2d.h"

void kernel_fdtd_2d(
    double ex[20][30],
    double ey[20][30],
    double hz[20][30],
    double _fict_[20]) {
  const int tmax = 20;
  const int nx = 20;
  const int ny = 30;

  for (int t = 0; t < tmax; t++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
      ey[0][j] = _fict_[t];
    }

    for (int i = 1; i < nx; i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
        ey[i][j] = ey[i][j] - 0.5 * (hz[i][j] - hz[i - 1][j]);
      }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      for (int j = 1; j < ny; j++) {
        ex[i][j] = ex[i][j] - 0.5 * (hz[i][j] - hz[i][j - 1]);
      }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < nx - 1; i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < ny - 1; j++) {
        hz[i][j] = hz[i][j] - 0.7 * (ex[i][j + 1] - ex[i][j] +
                                      ey[i + 1][j] - ey[i][j]);
      }
    }
  }
}
